author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-auto-gamma v2: Refined γ Selector + Balanced Cosine kNN (k=42)
abstract: Refines label-free γ selection: grid {0.72,0.74,0.75,0.76}; among γ with PCR within 1% of minimum, choose the one maximizing a batch-only mixing proxy (remove conservative tie-break). Then build batch-balanced cosine kNN (k=42, binary). Goal: recover ≈0.707 SOTA without manual γ.
